does_not_depend_on: any corpus's vocabulary of admissible coordinate values
added_arm.rule: Complete every coordinate stated on exactly one side with each of two witnesses -- the value the other side states, and a synthetic value distinct from it -- and run compare_meaning on every combination. If the relation is the same for all of them, return it. Otherwise return UNRESOLVED.
added_arm.two_witnesses_are_complete: every branch of compare_meaning tests an absent coordinate only for equality with the mirror value, so the relation as a function of what the silent source might have said takes at most the two values these witnesses produce

circularity_analysis.accuracy: No. A3 reproduces gold on all 33 cases, and that is its definition restated, not a measurement. No accuracy number for A3 over this corpus is reported anywhere.
circularity_analysis.but_it_collapses_on_this_corpus: On a corpus where the candidate reproduces gold on every case, its harm is zero by arithmetic -- there is no case left on which it can be wrong -- so the harm number carries nothing the accuracy number did not already carry. A3 reproduces gold on all 33. The zero is therefore entailed by the circular accuracy and may not be cited as safety.
circularity_analysis.consequence: G9_HARM_A3 runs CANNOT_CHECK. The repair is designed and unfalsified; it is not demonstrated safe, and the runner says so rather than reporting a zero it did not earn.
circularity_analysis.detected_mechanically_by: reading expected.authority.derivation.rule off each corpus's own case records and matching the marker 'completion-invariance', plus a per-arm exact-agreement count and a per-arm harm denominator. No corpus id is hard-coded as circular.
circularity_analysis.harm_is_a_different_question_in_general: Harm asks whether a decision A0 already got right was moved to a wrong one. No gold-derivation rule fixes that: it is a three-way comparison between A0, the candidate and gold, and an arm can be inaccurate without being harmful and harmful without being inaccurate overall.
circularity_analysis.question: research/p3-partial-observation-harm-v1/ derives its gold by asking whether the relation is constant over the admissible completions of a one-sided absence. That is A3's decision rule. Can that corpus score A3?
circularity_analysis.the_other_corpora: INTACT_DERIVATION, INTACT_HELDOUT_REAL and INTACT_HELDOUT_SYNTHETIC contain no one-sided absence, so A3 is A0 on every one of their pairs and its zero harm there is the same structural zero G6_HARM_A1 carried before amendment 001. The three probe corpora have gold UNRESOLVED on all 48 cases and A0 answers none of them correctly, so they carry no harm denominator; A1, A2 and A3 all abstain on all 48 and are indistinguishable there.
circularity_analysis.the_two_functions_are_not_identical: arm_decisive_absence_only and gold_from_standard differ in their inner relation rule (compare_meaning against the builder's independently written precedence rule), in their completion set (two witnesses derived from the pair against three values from the frozen corpus vocabulary) and in their domain (A3 answers a pair with several one-sided absences; gold_from_standard raises). They disagree on a pair whose stated side uses a value outside that vocabulary. The circularity is a fact about this corpus's coverage, not about A3 being gold.
circularity_analysis.what_would_discharge_it: an intact corpus with one-sided absences whose gold is fixed by adjudication, or by any rule that does not ask whether the completions agree, containing at least one partially observed pair A0 answers correctly

defect_under_repair.diagnosis: A1_observedness_asymmetric returns UNRESOLVED whenever a coordinate is stated on exactly one side. That abstains on the presence of an absence. What warrants abstention is that the absence changes the answer, and on the twelve H_UNDECISIVE_ABSENCE pairs it does not: a strictly higher-precedence coordinate already decides, so A1 destroys an answer compare_meaning already had right. The defect is in A1's design, not in the measurement.
defect_under_repair.reported_by: the runner itself, as gate G6_HARM_A1, under amendment 001
defect_under_repair.reported_detail: A1 could fire on 27 intact pairs, moved 21 decisions and destroyed 12 correct answers
defect_under_repair.why_g6_is_not_repointed: G6_HARM_A1 names A1 and reports a measured harm. That is a finding and it stays reproducible. Pointing the failing gate at the arm that repairs A1 would turn a failure into a pass by changing the gate's subject. G6 keeps its statement, its threshold, its arm and its FAIL; amendment 002 adds gates that answer for A3.

gate_statement: A3_decisive_absence_only destroys 0 correct answers on every intact corpus, and at least one intact corpus supplies independent evidence for that zero.

G10_BENEFIT_A3.note: probe gold is UNRESOLVED on every probe case, so an arm that abstains unconditionally scores the same 0.0. A1 and A2 do. This gate therefore shows that A3 keeps A1's intended benefit; it is not evidence that A3 is better than A1, and the separation fields say so with a number.
G10_BENEFIT_A3.statement: A3_decisive_absence_only's P3.OVERRESOLVED_UNRESOLVED_CASE violation rate is 0.0 on every probe corpus, i.e. it still abstains everywhere the frozen probe gold says abstention is right; and report whether any corpus separates A3 from A1

G9_HARM_A3.circularity_note: research/p3-partial-observation-harm-v1/ derives its gold by identity:observed-coordinate-precedence-with-completion-invariance --- abstain where the admissible completions of the absent coordinate disagree. That is A3's decision rule. On that corpus A3 agrees with gold by construction, so neither its accuracy nor its harm there is a measurement of A3, and this gate refuses both. The three corpora frozen on 2026-08-21 have no one-sided absence at all, so A3 cannot fire on them and its zero there is structural, exactly the emptiness G6 carried before amendment 001.
G9_HARM_A3.discharged_by: an intact corpus with one-sided absences whose gold is fixed by adjudication or by a rule that does not ask whether the completions agree, containing at least one partially observed pair A0 answers correctly
G9_HARM_A3.statement: A3_decisive_absence_only destroys 0 correct answers on every intact corpus, and at least one intact corpus supplies independent evidence for that zero: it has a harm denominator (a pair A0 answers correctly and A3 can fire on), its gold is not derived by the completion-invariance criterion A3 decides by, and A3 does not reproduce its gold on every case
G9_HARM_A3.why_a_separate_gate: G6_HARM_A1 names A1_observedness_asymmetric and reports a measured harm of 12 destroyed answers. That is a finding. Repointing it at the arm that repairs A1 would turn a failing gate into a passing one by changing its subject, which is the relabelling this repository keeps finding. G6 keeps failing for A1; this gate carries A3 and answers for A3 alone.

amendment_001.note: the vacuity note above is a true statement about the three corpora frozen on 2026-08-21 and is left standing.
